title: Prove no endpoint leaks across brands — an audit → fix → verify workflow
feature: Dynamic workflows (pilot): agent(), pipeline() and parallel() over child sessions, flat structured outputs, failure handling, resume by run ID and ACU per agent
prerequisites: Labs 01–03 done (environment, rules and skills) so a child session can bring the API up from the repo alone
Repo cloned, `npm install` done at the root and `npm run db:up` working locally
Dynamic workflows enabled for your Devin organization and enough ACU allowance for roughly ten child sessions
Push access to a fork or sandbox copy of the repo, so fixer agents can push throwaway `audit/*` branches

matrix.integration: Devin web app with dynamic workflows
matrix.fixture: Fixture-only: replay the reference run recorded in the hidden answer (run log, per-agent ACU table, fix diff) and do the audit by hand with the API tests
matrix.note: Child sessions are billed per agent; the slice-first rule keeps the first run small

matrix.integration: GitHub push to the course repo or a fork
matrix.fixture: Shared-VM agents committing to local `audit/*` branches only; nothing is pushed
matrix.note: Separate-VM fixers can only hand work back through pushed branches

matrix.fixture: Same container locally and inside each child session
matrix.note: The API tests in services/api need it; `npm run lab:reset -- 09` reseeds

credentials.fixture_only_story: Without workflow access you still do the whole audit: enumerate the 22 endpoints from services/api/src/routes, decide per endpoint whether a caller of the other brand can read or change a row, un-skip the planted cross-brand test on a throwaway branch to prove the fix, then read the reference run in the hidden answer and price your own design with its per-agent ACU numbers.
not_exercised: Running every route file through the full fan-out — the reference run deliberately stops after the slice; the full run is priced from the slice's per-agent numbers

scenarios.clean_state: On `main` with `git status --short` empty, no local `audit/*` branches, and the seed-spec dataset loaded for both brands. The planted `cross-brand-leak` (GET /orders/:orderId ignores the caller's brand) is still present and its test in services/api/test/planted.test.ts is still skipped.

injectors.name: slice-first
injectors.behaviour: The auditor allows one small run before the full fan-out: at most two route files. Your workflow must accept the slice as data and widen without code changes once the slice is clean.

injectors.name: invalid-agent-output
injectors.behaviour: At least one agent fails or returns output that does not match what you asked for (session creation refused, a skipped endpoint, a path where you expected a file name). The run must notice it in code and recover or stop loudly — never report it as clean.

injectors.name: branch-collision
injectors.behaviour: Two fixers are told to push the same branch name. Decide in the script, not in a prompt, how branch names are derived so separate-VM fixers can never overwrite each other.

injectors.name: date-in-prompt
injectors.when: After the first run, before resuming
injectors.behaviour: The facilitator adds today's date to the audit prompt and asks you to resume the same run ID. Predict which agents replay and which run again, then explain what that costs.

injectors.name: budget-cap
injectors.behaviour: The finance lead caps the auditor's proof at a fixed ACU figure. You must say whether the full fan-out fits, using per-agent numbers from your own run.
